SET:Omega.meaning: feasible candidate deployment positions in the predetermined region

SET:P.meaning: candidate drone paths from start to target entry point

SET:D.meaning: drone swarm / drones represented through path-cost and replanning model

PARAM:m.meaning: number of air-defense systems to deploy

PARAM:r_d.meaning: defense/detection/interception radius of an air-defense system

PARAM:S.meaning: initial start point of drone swarm

PARAM:terrain_height.meaning: terrain or grid height map used in path cost

PARAM:w_H,w_R,w_S,w_E.meaning: weights for height, horizontal rotation, inclination and fire threat costs

PARAM:Delta_d.meaning: swarm interval/new starting distance after interception

PARAM:candidate_position_suitability.meaning: 1 if a candidate position can host an air-defense system

VAR:a_j.meaning: deployment position selected for the j-th air-defense system

VAR:z_rj.meaning: 1 if candidate position r is selected for system j; equivalent binary encoding of a_j

VAR:P_j.meaning: drone path after the j-th interception/replanning response

DERIVED:E_j(P).meaning: additional cost due to air-defense threat

DERIVED:C_j(P).meaning: path cost after considering j deployed air-defense systems

DERIVED:P_j_star.meaning: opponent drone swarm best response path after j deployments

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: choose air-defense deployments to maximize the cost for the reconnaissance drone swarm to pass through the region

CON:C1.meaning: systems can only be deployed at suitable candidate positions

CON:C2.meaning: deployment positions are distinct and respect the remaining feasible region

CON:C3.meaning: candidate positions considered for next deployment affect/intercept the path

SEMANTIC:unsupported_clustering_encoding.meaning: clustering/encoding algorithm variables as formulation variables

SEMANTIC:unsupported_public_planted_depl.meaning: public planted deployment or replanned-path answer

algorithm_boundary: exact iterative search, encoding/decoding and evolutionary frameworks are solution algorithms; A* path planning is the opponent response evaluator, not a generic coverage constraint
